content: Seikop Kapaiahda Epraim oh Manase
Kedekedeo, pakair ehu ahpw wiawihong Sosep me dene semeo me ekis luwet. Ih eri ketikihda sapwellime pwutak riemeno, Epraim oh Manase, oh ketila rehn Seikop.
Ni Seikop eh rongada me nah pwutak, Sosep, ketiket kodohng reh, e tihnainda oh mwohdada nan dewe peht.
Seikop eri nadiong Sosep, “Koht, Wasa Lapalap, ketin pwarohng ie nan Lus nan Kenan, oh ketin kupwuramwahwih ie.
E mahsanihong ie, ‘I pahn kangederehla noumw seri kan, oh kadaudokomw kan pahn wiahla wehi ngeder. I pahn kihong irail sahpw wet pwe re en sapwenikihla kohkohlahte.’”
Seikop pil mahsanih, “Eri, I pahn nainekihla noumw pwutak riemen me ipwidier nan Isip mwohn ei pwarodo met. Epraim oh Manase pahn wiahla nei pwutak, duwehte Reupen oh Simion.
A seri kan me pahn ipwidi mwurira, kowe me pahn naineki; oh re pahn iang ale sohsohn riarail Epraim oh Manase.

I wia met pwe ni ei pwurodo sang Mesopodamia, omw nohno Resel kahrehiong ie lapalahn nsensuwed ni eh mehla nan Kenan, ekis dohsang Eprat. Ngehi eri sarepidi liho wasao, limwahn ahl me kodohng Eprat.” (Eprat iei Pedleem.)
Ni Seikop eh kilangada nein Sosep pwutak ko, e ahpw idek, “Ihs pwutak kan?”
Sosep eri sapeng, “Ih nei pwutak kan met, me Koht ketikihong ie nan Isip.” Seikop ahpw nda, “Kahreiradohng ie mahs pwe I en kapaiairahda.”
Mesen Seikop ko ediedlahr pwehki eh ohl laudlahr, oh e sohte kilang mwahu wasa. Sosep eri karehdohng reh nah pwutak ko, a Seikop pwoaloirahdi oh metik ira.
Seikop eri ndaiong Sosep, “Sohla ei koapworopwor en pwurehng tuhwong uhk, ahpw iet Koht ketin kupwure pwe I en pil tuhwong noumw pwutak kat.”
Sosep eri kihsang pwutak ko pohn nehn Seikop ko oh poaridi lel nanpwel.
Sosep eri kihla Epraim palimeing en Seikop a Manase palimaun.
Seikop ahpw kapisereihdi peh ko oh kihdi peh palimaun pohn moangen Epraim me tikitiko, a peh palimeing pohn moangen Manase me laudo.
Ih eri kapaiahda Sosep
patohwan,

content.text: “Koht me semei ko, Eipraam oh Aisek, kin papah, en ketin kupwuramwahwih pwutak kat!
Koht me ketin kakahluwa ie lel rahnwet, en ketin kupwuramwahwih ira!
Tohnlengo me ketin kapitiesang nan me suwed koaros, en pil ketin kupwuramwahwih ira!
Mwarei, oh mwaren semei ko Eipraam oh Aisek, en poatopoatete rehn pwutak kat!
Ira en neitik seri tohto, oh kadaudokara kan en ngeder!”

content: Ni Sosep eh kilang duwen semeo eh kihdiong pohn moangen Epraim peh palimaun, e ahpw nsensuwedkihla. Ih eri kihsang pehn semeo pohn moangen Epraim pwe en kidahng pohn moangen Manase.
E ahpw ndaiong semeo, “Ipa, kaidehkin ih pahn duwe men. Pwe iet me laudo; eri, kihdiong powe pehmw palimaunen.”
Semeo ahpw sapeng, nda, “I ese, samwa, I ese. Kadaudok en Manase kan pahn pil wiahla wehi lapalap ehu. Ahpw rie me tikitiket pahn lapalapasang, oh kadaudoke kan pahn wiahla wehi ngedehrie.”

Ih eri kapaiairahda rahno, ketihtihki, “Mehn Israel kan pahn kin kapaiahda aramas akan ni edomwa. Re pahn nda, ‘Koht en ketin kupwurei kumwail pwe kumwail en duwehte Epraim oh Manase.’ ” Ih duwen met Seikop eh mwohnekihla Epraim sang Manase.
Seikop eri ndahng Sosep, “Kilang, pwe I nektehn mehla, a Koht pahn ketin ieiang uhk, oh e pahn ketin kahreiukalahng nan sapwen omw pahpa kahlap ako.
Kowe me I pahn kihong Sekem,
a kaidehk riomw ko. Sekem wasa kaselelo me I kalowehkihdi nei kedlahs oh kesik ketieu sang mehn Amor.”

footnotes.text: SOSEP: Kapai me Seikop wiahiong Epraim oh Manase, ni mehlel e kihla kapai pwukat ong Sosep.
SEKEM: Ahd wet ni mahsen en Ipru wehwehki “wasa kaselel.”
